title: About Corvit
content: Corvit is one of Pakistan's long-running IT training institutes, best known for computer networking education. It trains students on vendor technologies from Cisco, Huawei, Juniper, Microsoft, VMware, Aruba and Red Hat, covering routing, switching, security, wireless, data centre and cloud topics. Over the years it has widened its course catalogue beyond networking into web development, cyber security, data science, cloud/DevOps, graphic design and digital marketing.

title: Networking courses
content: Networking is Corvit's flagship track. Typical courses include CCNA and CCNP (Cisco routing & switching), Huawei HCIA/HCIP, Juniper JNCIA, network security, wireless networking and data-centre technologies. These suit students who enjoy working with infrastructure, want a telecom/ISP/enterprise-IT career, or plan to sit vendor certification exams.

title: Web development courses
content: Web development courses cover HTML, CSS, JavaScript, front-end frameworks such as React, back-end basics, and WordPress site building. Good fit for students who want to freelance, build products, or move into software/web roles.

title: Cyber security courses
content: Cyber security offerings include ethical hacking (CEH-aligned), digital forensics (CHFI-aligned), and network security fundamentals. Suited to students who like problem solving under a security lens and want SOC analyst, penetration tester or security-admin roles.

title: Data science & AI courses
content: Data science and AI courses teach Python, statistics, machine learning fundamentals and applied AI. A good match for students with a maths/stats background, or CS graduates who want analytics, ML or AI-adjacent roles.

title: Cloud & DevOps courses
content: Cloud and DevOps courses cover AWS/Azure fundamentals, virtualization, containers and CI/CD basics. Recommended for students who already know some networking or Linux and want to move into cloud infrastructure or DevOps roles.

title: Graphic design courses
content: Graphic design courses cover design software, print media design and UI basics. Good for creatively minded students who want design, branding or UI/UX-adjacent careers.

title: Digital marketing courses
content: Digital marketing courses cover SEO, social media marketing and e-commerce basics. A fit for business-minded students who want to run marketing for a company or freelance for clients.

title: Which course fits which student
content: Quick fit guide the assistant should reason with: interested in infrastructure/telecom -> Networking. Wants to build apps/websites/freelance -> Web Development. Security-minded, likes investigating -> Cyber Security. Strong in maths/stats, wants analytics/AI -> Data Science & AI. Already knows networking/Linux, wants ops roles -> Cloud & DevOps. Creative/artistic -> Graphic Design. Business-minded, wants to market products -> Digital Marketing. If a student is undecided, ask about their background (education, interests, prior IT exposure) and time availability (can they commit to a fixed NAVTTC schedule, or need evening/weekend flexibility) before recommending.
